hero.headline:
Your private villa
in Marrakech,
exclusively yours
hero.subheadline: Five suites around a riad-style patio, a pool, a hammam and an olive garden, all to yourselves. Up to 14 guests.

home.welcome_body: Our suites, arranged around a riad-inspired patio, offer a calm and enchanting setting. Admire the starry sky from the patio, enjoy the fireplace lounge and a dining room seating up to 14 guests. The ethnic, bohemian decor — sourced and customised by Marrakech artisans — creates a warm, elegant atmosphere.
home.suites_sub: Each suite is a world of its own: every hue was chosen to evoke unique emotions, in harmony with Marrakchi craftsmanship.
home.experiences_sub: Traditional hammam, massage room, fitness room, pétanque court, badminton and table tennis — plus the garden with its koi pond and Buddha statue.
home.cta_body: The entire villa, exclusively — 7 bedrooms, sleeping 14. Ideal for family gatherings, golf trips and seminars.

golf.page_sub: 11 championship courses within 30 minutes — bespoke golf stays.
golf.intro: Villa Serena sits at the heart of Marrakech's golfing constellation — the ideal base camp for a golf trip with friends or family, minutes from courses designed by some of the world's greatest architects.

featured.name: PalmGolf Marrakech Ourika
featured.description: The closest, on the same axis as the villa. With stunning views over the Atlas mountains, Palm Golf Ourika is a must-play course in the region, designed in a desert style by Canadian duo Neil Haworth and Stéphane Talbot.

featured.name: Akenza Golf
featured.description: Marrakech's new jewel (2025). Designed by Kyle Phillips, architect of the legendary Kingsbarns. Canyons and wadis, eight ravine crossings, an anthology-worthy 7th hole.

featured.name: Samanah Country Club
featured.description: The Jack Nicklaus signature. The first course in Africa to host a PGA Champions Tour event. Clubhouse inspired by Marrakech's ramparts.

golf.table_note: Beyond these three nearest greens, eight more courses complete the picture — eleven courses in all, designed by Nicklaus, Kyle Phillips, Robert Trent Jones, Cabell Robinson and Colin Montgomerie, all set against the Atlas mountains.

courses.name: Golf Al Maaden
courses.architect: Kyle Phillips (2010) · Moroccan garden & sculpture park

faq.label: Frequently asked questions
faq.title: Good to know before you book

items.a: The villa is in Sidi Bouzguia, about 25 minutes from the centre of Marrakech and Jemaa el-Fna square, and about 25 minutes from Marrakech-Menara airport.

items.q: How many guests can the villa sleep?
items.a: Villa Serena has five suites and sleeps up to 14 guests. The dining room also seats up to 14.

items.q: Can I book a single room?
items.a: No. The villa is only hired in full, exclusively: you do not share it with any other guests.

items.q: How do I book and find out the rate?
items.a: Enter your dates and the number of guests on the enquiry page. We confirm availability and the rate for the villa within 24 hours, with no commitment.

items.q: Which services are available on site?
items.a: Breakfast and daily housekeeping are included. On request: meals prepared by the villa's cook, traditional hammam, massages and excursions. The gym, pétanque, badminton and table tennis are free to use.
Yes, a transfer from Marrakech-Menara airport can be arranged on request.

items.q: Can we host a wedding, seminar or retreat?
items.a: Yes. The villa can be hired exclusively for weddings, birthdays, seminars and yoga or wellness retreats. Each event is quoted individually.
